methodology.benchmarkThreads: one browser benchmark at a time, no concurrent test/build jobs
methodology.comparisonSelection: High Q/R/K and mixed army use original baseline vs final sweep. High siege and Low extreme use fresh-process paired repeats after timing spikes. Low Q/R use the medians of three fresh-process pairs with one pair in reversed order. Low M/T use original sweeps.
methodology.variance: Some sweeps have large host timing spikes in both baseline and updated code. Every final sweep and fresh-process repeat is retained below. Do not interpret the noisy Low K reduction as an optimization gain; its updated repeat also beats the original stable 194.34ms mean / 320.1ms p95 baseline.
methodology.limits: Headless Chromium on the recorded shared host. Synthetic sustained health retains all actors. These are not real-device FPS guarantees.
